pdfUrls.title: PDF URLs
pdfUrls.description: Direct links to PDF files. Each PDF becomes one dataset item with its Markdown.

extractTables.title: Convert tables to Markdown tables
extractTables.description: Detect ruled tables and output them as Markdown tables instead of loose text.

ocrScannedPages.title: OCR scanned pages
ocrScannedPages.description: Run OCR (Tesseract) on pages that have no text layer, such as scans. Charged per OCR page.

ocrLanguage.title: OCR language
ocrLanguage.description: Tesseract language code(s), e.g. eng, fra, deu, spa, ita, por, nld, or several joined with + (eng+fra).

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Only convert the first N pages of each PDF. 0 = all pages.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many PDFs to download and convert in parallel.
